cells.quote: However, the present study showed that the relationship between sleep quality and academic achievements was statistically non-significant.
cells.note: The study reports no significant relationship but no power or equivalence test; no effect size is printed.

cells.quote: The multivariate logistic regression analysis showed significantly lower odd ratios among medical students who always have a regular sleep schedule than those who never have a regular sleep schedule (AOR,0.349; CI, 0.129–0.940) p = 0.037.
cells.note: Lower odds of poor sleep quality were interpreted as better sleep quality.

cells.quote: Additionally, fourth-year medical students showed lesser odds of having poor sleep quality than second-year medical students (AOR, 0.381; CI, 0.158–0.934) p = 0.035.
cells.note: The treatment group had lower odds of poor sleep quality.
